about: Leviticus is the book of the priests. It teaches God's people how to worship and how to be holy.

pages.title: The Priests
pages.scene: Aaron the high priest in his special clothes
pages.text: God chose Aaron and his sons to be priests. They wore special clothes. They helped the people pray and bring gifts to God. They taught the people God's ways. When everything was ready, God's glory shone, and all the people shouted for joy!
pages.lesson: We can come close to God and worship Him.

pages.title: Be Holy
pages.scene: A farmer leaving grain at the edge of the field for the poor
pages.text: God told His people, "Be holy, because I am holy." That means living God's way. Leave some food in your fields for poor people. Be fair. Don't be unkind to people who can't see or hear. And most important: love your neighbor as yourself.

pages.title: Happy Holidays
pages.scene: A family celebrating a feast together
pages.text: God gave His people special days to celebrate. They rested every seventh day. They had feasts to remember how God set them free. They thanked Him for the harvest. Every fiftieth year, everyone got a fresh start!
pages.lesson: Remember what God has done, and celebrate!
